name: repobrain
description: Remember the code your AI agents write: spaced-repetition cards from merged changes, drafted by your own Claude.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.build.json && rm -rf dist && esbuild src/bin.ts src/hook-bin.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --outdir=dist --log-level=warning
scripts.check:dist: npm run build && git diff --exit-code --stat -- dist
